cover.desc: Full color, warm and loud. Interior of Kotobuki-yu in the early evening, lamp-yellow light on old tile and wood. Nagi is mid-stride across the changing room with a stack of yellow baskets under one arm and a cloth over her shoulder, wearing her indigo happi with the sleeves shoved past the elbow — face completely deadpan, walking as if nothing unusual is happening. Attached to the back of her happi, both fists knotted in the fabric, feet dragging along the floorboards behind her, is Sōta: six years old, damp-haired, wearing an expression of total triumphant possession. Behind them, out of focus, Itsuki leans on the bandai counter with a towel round his neck, laughing helplessly. Far background: the fish clock, and the massage chair. Nobody in the picture is looking at the camera. The warmth should read as domestic, not romantic — this is a picture of a household that does not exist yet.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: grave, hands behind back, presenting a case
chars.pose: standing very straight in front of the kotatsu

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: chopsticks halfway to his mouth
chars.pose: cross-legged, mid-dinner

panels.bg: the Nomura apartment, evening, dinner on the kotatsu, one lamp
panels.action: Day eleven of the campaign.

dialogue.text: I have a plan. About the chair.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: >_<, arms thrown wide, tiny body huge head
chars.pose: chibi, standing on the kotatsu

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: dot eyes, retreating
chars.pose: chibi, leaning back with his bowl held clear

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: unimpressed, eating steadily through the entire event
chars.pose: chibi, not looking up

panels.bg: chaos lines, starburst screentone
panels.action: Comedy spike, and the only one this chapter — it happens at home, four streets from the bathhouse.

chars.name: mio
chars.expression: flat, pen already back in her hand
chars.pose: textbook open beside her bowl

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: half-turned, asking without really asking
chars.pose: collecting bowls

panels.bg: kotatsu, lamp, dark window
panels.action: He offers. She declines. Neither of them makes anything of it.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: radiant, arms out, shoes already off
chars.pose: bursting through the noren at a dead run

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: trailing, bag over one shoulder
chars.pose: coming in behind him at walking pace

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance from inside, Saturday evening, warm lamp, sandal rack, quiet building
panels.action: The noren does not so much lift as get through.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reflex, not thinking about it
chars.pose: setting coins down on the counter tray

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up from her book
chars.pose: seated at the bandai, one finger pushing the coins back across the tray

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp
panels.action: One finger. She does not look up and she does not explain. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: looking at the pushed-back coins, something going quiet in his face
chars.pose: hand hovering over the tray

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Four hundred and forty yen, returned without comment, three chapters late. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: deadpan, carrying on regardless
chars.pose: walking with a stack of baskets

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: attached, delighted
chars.pose: gripping the back of her happi, feet dragging

panels.bg: changing room, baskets, worn floorboards, warm lamp
panels.action: He has selected her. There was no interview.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unbothered, crouched at her work
chars.pose: wiping the low sink, small boy still attached to her back

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: chin on her shoulder, supervising
chars.pose: clinging

panels.bg: low sink, tiled wall, warm lamp
panels.action: She works around him the way you work around weather.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: watching from the counter, arms folded, amused and slightly displaced
chars.pose: leaning on the bandai

panels.bg: changing room seen from the counter, the two of them small at the far side
panels.action: It has taken his brother eleven minutes to get further in than he did in three weeks.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: narrow-eyed, professional
chars.pose: standing in front of the massage chair with his hands on his hips

panels.bg: rest area, the ancient vinyl massage chair, faded instruction decal, tatami bench
panels.action: The chair and the boy regard one another.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: grunting with effort, entirely serious
chars.pose: kicking the base of the chair with the flat of his foot

panels.bg: rest area, chair, warm lamp
panels.action: Phase one. Full realism. No chibi anywhere in this building.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, not intervening
chars.pose: passing behind with an armful of towels

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: mid-kick
chars.pose: attacking the chair

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp
panels.action: She has decided this is between them.

dialogue.text: It ate a hundred yen off me too.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: vanishing headfirst into the gap
chars.pose: squeezing behind the chair, legs sticking out

panels.bg: back of the massage chair, dusty wall, cables
panels.action: Phase two. He goes round the back, where nobody has been since the Showa era.

panels.bg: a fat old two-pin plug lying loose on the dusty floorboards behind the chair, its socket eight centimetres away, both furred with grey dust
panels.action: It was never broken.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: eyes enormous with the magnitude of his discovery
chars.pose: both hands on the plug, pushing it home

panels.bg: behind the chair, dust, cables, one hanging bulb
panels.action: Nobody tell him it was unplugged for eighteen years. He would be unbearable.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: airborne, mouth wide open, ecstatic
chars.pose: flung half out of the seat as the chair convulses

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: lunging, drink abandoned mid-air
chars.pose: diving across the tatami

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: the largest expression she has made in five chapters — eyes fully open, mouth open
chars.pose: towels dropping out of her arms

panels.bg: rest area, the massage chair thrashing violently back to life, dust exploding off it, towels in the air, fish clock rocking on its nail
panels.action: Eighteen years of stored intent, released. Full realism, and funnier for it.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: entirely unsurprised, milk bottle in hand
chars.pose: standing in the doorway of the rest area, having watched the whole thing

panels.bg: rest area doorway, dust still settling, the chair juddering
panels.action: Fusae-san has been coming here since 1963 and has seen worse.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: eyes shut, expression of profound and total peace
chars.pose: settled deep into the juddering chair, milk bottle balanced on her stomach

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: standing guard beside her, immensely proud
chars.pose: hands on hips

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: wheezing
chars.pose: sitting on the floor where he landed

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, dust motes in the air, tatami bench
panels.action: A dead thing in the building started working again. Nobody in the room says anything about that.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: standing back, holding the dropped towels, something complicated behind the eyes
chars.pose: watching the chair work

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, blurred figures
panels.action: Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: amused, eyes still shut
chars.pose: in the chair, addressing the boy without looking at him

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: formal, chin up
chars.pose: standing to attention

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp
panels.action: Introductions, conducted properly.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: one eye opening, nodding toward the counter
chars.pose: tilting her head

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: following the nod, answering instantly
chars.pose: turning to point

panels.bg: rest area, the counter and Nagi visible beyond
panels.action: He answers without thinking about it, because he has already worked all this out.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: matter-of-fact, arm out, stating a known fact
chars.pose: pointing across the room at the counter

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: gone completely still behind the counter
chars.pose: hands stopped on a stack of towels

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: head coming up, mouth opening
chars.pose: still sitting on the floor

panels.bg: rest area and counter in one frame, warm lamp, the width of the room between them
panels.action: The word is not neechan. The word is the one before it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mouth open on a correction that does not come out
chars.pose: half-risen, hand up

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, blurred
panels.action: He was going to say she isn't. He finds he can't be bothered to be right about it.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely nothing on her face, eyes down on the towels
chars.pose: hands starting to move again, folding

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: Nobody corrects him. Nobody laughs. She folds the towel she is holding, and then folds it again. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, leaving
chars.pose: walking out of the room with the towels

panels.bg: the counter and the doorway to the bath hall, steam beyond, warm lamp behind her
panels.action: She takes the towels somewhere they do not need to go. Silent.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: eyes screwed shut, mouth enormous, absolutely inconsolable
chars.pose: staggering out of the bath door in a towel, both fists jammed into his eyes

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: flustered, apologising, hands hovering uselessly
chars.pose: following him out, towel round his neck

panels.bg: changing room, steam rolling out of the open bath door, warm lamp
panels.action: Twenty minutes later. Somebody has got shampoo in somebody's eyes.

dialogue.text: I know. I know. Sorry. Sorry—

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: genuinely rattled, out of his depth for once
chars.pose: crouched, trying to prise a small fist away from an eye

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: howling
chars.pose: twisting away

panels.bg: changing room floor, baskets, warm lamp
panels.action: He is good at this. He is not good at this while being watched.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already crossing the room, not hurrying
chars.pose: walking over with a cloth still in one hand

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: mid-howl
chars.pose: on the floor

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: looking up
chars.pose: crouched

panels.bg: changing room, low sink at the far wall, warm lamp
panels.action: She does not ask what happened. She takes the boy's wrist and walks him to the low sink.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: calm, businesslike, saying nothing at all
chars.pose: crouched at the low sink, tipping the boy's head back with one hand under his chin

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: hiccuping, going quiet because someone competent has arrived
chars.pose: head tipped back, fists coming down

panels.bg: the low sink in the corner of the changing room, tap running, tiled splashback, warm lamp
panels.action: Water on. No instructions given, because none are needed yet.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her palm laid flat across the boy's forehead as a visor, and two fingers tapping twice on his hairline

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: eyes closing on the second tap, automatically
chars.pose: head back under her hand

panels.bg: the low sink, running water, tile, close and warm
panels.action: Palm flat. Two taps. Shut your eyes. No word is spoken and the boy understands it perfectly the first time.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: concentrating, entirely fluent
chars.pose: pouring water back over his hairline with her free hand, palm still shielding

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: eyes shut, calm, trusting
chars.pose: head back

panels.bg: low sink, running water, steam, warm lamp
panels.action: Eight seconds. It is over. He has stopped crying and does not remember starting.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand only
chars.pose: her hand stopped in mid-air over the boy's head, fingers still half-curled from the tap

panels.bg: low sink, water still running, flat screentone
panels.action: Her hand does not come down. It did something she did not decide to do. Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: eyes on Nagi's hands, not on her face — recognition, and no intention of mentioning it
chars.pose: standing in the rest area doorway with her milk bottle, not coming any closer

panels.bg: doorway, warm lamp behind her, the sink out of focus in the foreground
panels.action: Fusae-san has seen that hand do that exact thing before, over that exact sink, to a much smaller girl. She says nothing about it. Silent.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: comfortable, looking at the room in general
chars.pose: turning back toward the chair, bottle in both hands

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: hand finally lowering, towelling the boy's hair
chars.pose: crouched at the sink

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, the massage chair still humming somewhere off-panel
panels.action: One line, about the noise, which is not the thing.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: cheerful, conversational, wringing his own hair
chars.pose: sitting on the tatami bench with a bottle of milk

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: half-listening, tidying baskets
chars.pose: moving about the room

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, fish clock reading 8:14
panels.action: Sōta reports the news from home, because that is what six-year-olds are for.

dialogue.text: Mio said she didn't want to come.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: easy, not stopping
chars.pose: stacking a basket

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: swinging his legs, adding a detail
chars.pose: drinking

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp
panels.action: And then the detail.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hands stopped on the basket, eyes flat, catchlights gone
chars.pose: standing still in the middle of the room

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, blurred
panels.action: She wanted to be asked twice. He asked once. Silent.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: fading fast, milk bottle tipping
chars.pose: leaning further and further sideways on the bench

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: seated beside him doing the accounts, not noticing yet
chars.pose: ledger open on her knees, pen moving

panels.bg: tatami bench in the rest area, warm lamp, fish clock reading 8:39
panels.action: Gravity does what gravity does.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: fast asleep, mouth open
chars.pose: slumped sideways against her arm, head on her shoulder, bottle still in one fist

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: pen stopped, looking down at him
chars.pose: absolutely motionless so as not to wake him

panels.bg: tatami bench, warm lamp, ledger open and forgotten
panels.action: She does not move for a long time. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: the fear arriving — eyes widening slightly, jaw tightening
chars.pose: very still, child's weight against her shoulder

panels.bg: flat screentone, warm lamp glow
panels.action: This is what it would be like. That is the frightening part. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: controlled, brisk, not looking at either of them
chars.pose: lifting the sleeping boy off her shoulder and holding him out at arm's length

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: arriving, taking him, surprised by the speed
chars.pose: hands out, catching his brother

panels.bg: rest area, tatami bench, warm lamp
panels.action: She hands him back a little too fast, and then stands up and finds something to do.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: watching her go, working out what he just saw, deciding not to touch it
chars.pose: sleeping boy against his shoulder

panels.bg: rest area, warm lamp, her back receding toward the bath hall
panels.action: He knows exactly what that was. He has done it himself. He says nothing. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: quiet, sorting out a sleeve
chars.pose: crouched, working a jacket onto a limp sleeping arm

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: half-awake, boneless
chars.pose: swaying on his feet

panels.bg: genkan, sandal rack, warm lamp, cold night beyond the glass
panels.action: Getting a sleeping six-year-old into a coat. A two-man job done by one man for four years.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: n/a — hand only, small and half-asleep
chars.pose: laying his palm flat on his brother's forehead and tapping twice with two fingers

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: blinking, eyes closing on the second tap without deciding to
chars.pose: crouched, face tipped up

panels.bg: genkan, warm lamp, close and soft
panels.action: Forty minutes old and already passed on. Nobody in the building comments on it, because nobody in the building knows where it came from. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: seeing it happen from across the room, expression unreadable
chars.pose: stopped at the counter with a cloth in her hand

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, the genkan out of focus beyond
panels.action: She watches her own hands happen to somebody else. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: ordinary, warm, tired
chars.pose: at the noren with Sōta asleep on his back

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: at the counter, guarded again
chars.pose: standing

panels.bg: entrance, noren, cold clear night beyond
panels.action: The goodbye. He does not thank her for any of it, which is correct.

dialogue.text: We'll get out of your hair.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: half-turning at the noren, considering saying something
chars.pose: one hand lifting the curtain

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: waiting
chars.pose: hands at her sides

panels.bg: noren, warm light, night street
panels.action: He considers saying something about the towels, or the coins, or his brother. He does not.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: in the lit doorway, watching them go
chars.pose: one hand on the doorframe

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, walking
chars.pose: Sōta asleep on his back, twenty metres up the street

panels.bg: the shuttered shotengai at night, cold and clear, one warm doorway, long empty road
panels.action: That should be the end of it.

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: surfacing, head coming up off his brother's shoulder, wide awake for exactly four seconds
chars.pose: twisting round on Itsuki's back to shout back down the street

panels.bg: night street, forty metres from the bathhouse, cold clear air
panels.action: It is not the end of it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: wincing, apologetic, already fixing it
chars.pose: hitching him up, calling back over his shoulder

panels.bg: night street, the bathhouse light small behind them
panels.action: The responsible adult intervenes.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: hands cupped at her mouth, shouting — the first time in her life she has raised her voice in public
chars.pose: standing out on the wet stone in front of the noren, feet in her grandfather's sandals

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not visible — stopped dead, back turned, small at the far end of the frame
chars.pose: halted mid-step with his brother on his back

chars.name: sota
chars.expression: not visible — small, arms up
chars.pose: twisted round on his brother's back

panels.bg: the full length of the shuttered shotengai at night, cold blue-black, one warm doorway at the near end and two small figures at the far end. The shouted bubble crosses the empty street between them — the largest and loudest lettering in the chapter.
panels.action: She overrules him. Final panel, and the chapter ends on a sound.
